title: relay agent permissions
description: `relay setup` installs harness permission rules so the agent runs relay commands without a prompt and `relay human` commands still prompt.

title: Command forms
description:
List the command forms the agent uses to invoke relay.
owns: `command_forms(install_path)` in relay/forms.py
- [ ] `command_forms(install_path)` returns `relay` and the real path of `install_path`

title: Qualification record
description:
Add the qualification record that rules for a form are tied to.
owns: `Qualification(form, state, digest)` with `Qualification.pending(form)` and `Qualification.qualified(form, digest)` in relay/qualify.py
- [ ] `Qualification.pending(form)` has state `pending` and no digest
- [ ] `Qualification.qualified(form, digest)` has state `qualified` and carries the digest

title: Rule set from qualification records
description:
Rework `build_rules` in relay/rules.py to build rules from qualification records (B1).
owns: `build_rules(records)` returning the rules and the forms left without rules
consumes: `Qualification` from rl.2
- [ ] a `qualified` record for form F gives a prompt rule `F human *` and an allow rule `F *`
- [ ] a record that is not `qualified` gives no rule, and its form is returned as left without rules

title: Setup writes qualified rules
description:
Rework `run_setup` in relay/install.py so setup creates a pending qualification record per command form, builds the rule set from the records and writes it (B1).
owns: `run_setup(settings_path, install_path, out)` in relay/install.py
consumes: `command_forms` from rl.1, `Qualification.pending` from rl.2, `build_rules(records)` from rl.3
- [ ] `relay setup` creates a `pending` record for each command form
- [ ] for each form left without rules, `relay setup` prints `relay setup: F awaiting qualification; no rules written`
- [ ] `relay setup` replaces only relay-owned rules and leaves rules of other tools unchanged; running it twice gives the same file

title: Tests for qualified rules
description:
Cover the qualified rule set and setup in tests/ (B1).
consumes: `Qualification.qualified` from rl.2, `build_rules` from rl.3, `run_setup` from rl.4
- [ ] a test builds `qualified` records for `relay` and the absolute path with `Qualification.qualified` and checks `build_rules` gives allow rules for both forms and a `human` prompt rule for each (B1)
- [ ] a test runs `run_setup` and checks it writes no relay rule while records are `pending`, prints the notice and keeps other tools' rules
